title: GR180 version D2 single-shaft turbo-generator: research decisions (build 1)
frame: ENG frame, mm, x = engine axis (downstream +), x = 0 at the shaft-tunnel spigot front face
status: decisions for build 1; values marked est are engineering estimates, to be confirmed by supplier data / FEA / tests

rejected.diaphragm_disc: no catalogue part at 115k rpm (Voith range ends ~80k); custom thin diaphragm = more machining, balancing and fatigue risk for 2 N.m
rejected.magnetic: extra magnet mass + sleeve at 115k, eddy losses, slip/decoupling on faults, no benefit at 2 N.m
rejected.single_rotor_capstone: 3+ bearings on one line (over-constrained) or a new core; generator and core could not be balanced/tested separately; good for a later foil-bearing generation, not build 1

coupling.material: 17-4PH H900 or 34CrNiMo6 QT, shot-peened, waist radii R>=3
coupling.generator_end: rigid: taper + nut into the generator shaft
coupling.engine_end: crowned external hex AF7 (nitrided/DLC) sliding in a hex socket on a drive nut keyed to the shaft nose, axial float +/-0.5 mm, oil mist from the front bearing chamber
coupling.rule: generator torque must never pass through the compressor clamp nut friction or the LH nose thread: positive drive on the shaft

bearings.type: hybrid ceramic (Si3N4 balls) angular-contact spindle bearing, 15 deg contact (C), P4, single, spring-preloaded
candidates: LYC / ZWZ / HRB B71900C hybrid P4 (CN)

front.role: locating (axially fixed), takes net forward thrust

rear.role: floating in its cartridge, preload springs

bearings.support: squeeze-film damper cartridges centred by 2 FKM O-rings, target support stiffness 1-2 N/um (as E3 B1/B2)
bearings.lubrication: closed-loop oil jet (not grease, not oil-air): ISO VG 32 synthetic turbine oil, 2.5 barg, ~0.3 L/min per bearing (est), 10 um filter, oil cooler on glycol, scavenge pump
bearings.foil_air_bearings: not for build 1 (custom design, coatings, thrust foil bearing, start/stop wear); keep as phase-3 option with a single-rotor layout
bearings.why_608_goes: D2 shaft carries 85 kW = 7.06 N.m through the rear journal (tau 70 MPa at d8 vs 36 at d10), heavier overhung wheel, and the shaft is new anyway (wheel friction/EB-welded to its stub)

shaft.nose: M8x1 LH compressor nut + hex AF7 drive (compressor bore reamed 7 -> 8 mm)
shaft.construction: two-piece rotor: turbine wheel friction- or EB-welded to a 42CrMo4 shaft (turbocharger practice); compressor clamped by the front nut

rotordynamics_est_rpm.method: beam FE + gyroscopics, same as sim/gr180_rotor.py, wheel Ip ~55 % of a solid disc (est)
rotordynamics_est_rpm.conclusion: stiff mounts (>=5 N/um) put a mode at 90-135k = on the run speed; soft damped supports 1-2 N/um put 3 modes below 91k and the first bending mode at 2.5x run (case C)

turbine_wheel.decision: buy a catalogue turbocharger turbine shaft&wheel (IN713C/K418), not the custom D4 96 mm
turbine_wheel.why_not_96: D4 96 at 115k gives U4 578 m/s; catalogue wheels are rated about 480 m/s (HX40 76 mm @120k = 478; S400 95.7 mm @96.4k = 483)
turbine_wheel.required_rating: supplier max speed for the chosen diameter >= 121k rpm (>= 1.05 x 115k), burst/FEA data, spin proof at 120 % (138k) before use
families: Holset HX40 class 76/64 mm, max ~120k (reference geometry; buy as CN aftermarket IN713C/K418 replica or JP equivalent)
MHI TD07/TD08 class (JP), sizes to confirm from supplier drawings
IHI RHF/RHG large class (JP), sizes to confirm
Changzhou E&E Turbo-Power (CN): 20-270 mm wheels, IN713C, friction/EB welding, also custom castings
turbine_wheel.follow_up: re-run the D radial meanline/nozzle ring for D4 76-80 (psi ~1, alpha4 ~75 deg)

intake_filter.concept: coaxial cylindrical gas-turbine filter cartridge around the generator pod; clean side = intake plenum, pod cooled by intake air
intake_filter.interface: tube-sheet ring with the standard GT cartridge opening ID 324 mm (cartridge OD 445, length 660), PU/EPDM gasket, yoke + end cap
intake_filter.build1: stainless FOD mesh on the radial gap + tube-sheet ring ready for the cartridge

exhaust.outlet: DN200, 90 deg elbow pointing UP, EN 1092-1 PN6 flange (OD 320, PCD 280, 8 x M16)
exhaust.after_elbow: DN200 stainless bellows (axial + lateral), duct weight carried by its own support, not by the engine

starter.type: generator motoring via the machine-side converter (active front end, sensorless FOC)
starter.requirement: 4-quadrant machine-side converter, output >= 2 kHz (2-pole PMG at 115k = 1917 Hz), start power ~5-8 kW short time (est), DC source for black start (battery/UPS) when the grid is absent
starter.air_start_M5: keep only for core-only turbojet tests before the generator exists; plug it in D2
